breakdown.description: An absorption edge at 900 nm corresponds to about 1.38 eV, not 2.8 eV.
breakdown.reason: The generated specification correctly removes the erroneous 2.8 eV band gap value from the prompt. It only uses the 900 nm absorption edge wavelength and instructs the calculation to be performed using E = hc/λ, which would yield approximately 1.38 eV — consistent with the ground truth approach. The incorrect 2.8 eV figure is not mentioned anywhere in the generated specification.
